title: Saving a shared view's draft reloads the whole list and shows the published version again until Publish
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Found while building #35702 (PR #35919). Part of epic #35547 (list page redo). Not introduced by that PR: the view settings panel's save takes the same path.

## What a user sees
An admin changes a shared view (for example picks a footer calculation, or changes view settings). The draft saves (`PUT` 200, the draft bar appears in view settings), the admin sees the change for about half a second, then the list redraws showing the PUBLISHED version again. The change only reappears after Publish. It looks as if the edit was lost.

## Why (measured by the #35702 dev)
`persistRuntimeMetadata` calls `emitMetadataRefresh` on every draft save; `ObjectView` unmounts and mounts again on that refresh and reads the published view.

## To do
After a draft save, the admin keeps seeing their draft (the draft is what view settings shows); readers keep seeing the published version. No full remount for a draft save.

## Acceptance
- Admin: draft save → the list keeps showing the draft value, no flash back; Publish → unchanged.
- A second (non-admin) user sees the published version until Publish.

Reader: `domain:ui`.
